C-ARCHIVE-CORPUS-BASELINE-1-0AA78642.IntentSummary:
T1 plan for C-ARCHIVE-CORPUS-BASELINE-1-0AA78642, authored from the approved spec (SHA-256 `ca690ccd9b1222e19ed3402ec11718415a729cb82b581b3af564e273f5fcffe6`) at the plan-stage checkpoint `25997d7c667c451a62ad125546b6555c62633981` (the spec's own byte-invariance guards keep their authoring base `f346480034693efde289eb65920be1832d88d189` and are not rewritten). The owning module is `M-REVIEW` (`src/review/core.ts` declares `LINKS: M-REVIEW`), with `V-M-REVIEW` as its verification sibling. `.test.ts` and `.ngrace-lint.json` are not module-ownable write paths, so no synthetic `LINKS:` header or graph anchor is added for them.
**Ordering.** T-001 rewrites the archive-corpus regression in `src/review/core.test.ts`: it adds `HISTORICAL_CLOSE_C_IDS` (the 26 `AUTHORING_ARCHIVE_C_IDS` plus `C-SUBSTANTIATION-HONESTY`) and replaces the single over-broad test with a frozen historical-close zero, a retired-code-only scan over the complete current archive, and the real-CLI T-005 observability test. T-002 appends the single `bun run validate:ci` entry to `.ngrace-lint.json` `closeEvidenceCommandShapes`. The two writes are disjoint, but T-002 depends on T-001 only for ordering clarity and because the config prefix is meaningful only once the repaired suite and the whole-CI criterion it unblocks are both in place; the executor runs them serially with no concurrent workers, branches, or worktrees.
**All 11 approved `AC-*` are close-bound with complete `CloseEvidence`**, so no task carries `<Satisfies>`; a `Satisfies` of a close-bound criterion is an error and a close-bound criterion is not a forgotten mapping. The full CI-equivalent `bun run validate:ci` is the plan's `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` under `--assertions final --run-commands` before apply/archive, and it is also the post-archive `AC-CI-GREEN` `CloseEvidence`; the two runs are distinct obligations and the plan claims no invocation count. Per `ngrace-plan` rule 19 the same `CloseEvidence` commands and the full CI are driven in a faithful post-close planning copy before approval. `ObservedWriteScope` names the two production targets, the active run ledger artifacts (`run.xml`, `run-ledger.xml`, and the `run/**` loose-event glob), and the bundle's own archive arrival glob; the bundle's own `spec.xml`, `plan.xml`, and `design-context.xml` are not listed because review skips them by identity (rule 15). No record entry is paid and no record XML is flushed.
**T-005 identity note.** The spec names the retained finding id `792aa42b0c989c73`. That id is derived in part from the finding's anchor file (`src/review/core.ts:340-357`), and `resolveAttemptPairAnchorFile` (`src/review/core.ts:1371-1394`) resolves to `.../run` only while the empty, untracked `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-DECLARATION-GUARD-RETIRE-1-C69B6AB6/run/` directory is physically present; a fresh checkout has no such directory and the anchor becomes `.../run-ledger.xml`. The plan therefore asserts the T-005 finding's presence by its stable identity — `code` plus `anchorOrHunkKey` `attempt-pair:T-005:14->15` — and records the id it emits; it does not pin an id that changes across a fresh clone. This is surfaced to the authority rather than silently resolved against the approved spec.

A test titled to be selectable by `-t "historical close corpus"` enumerates the complete archive `C-*` directories, asserts every `HISTORICAL_CLOSE_C_IDS` member is present, then runs `runReview` over exactly the 27 historical members and asserts 0 live `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` and 0 retired `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` findings with both aggregates 0. It asserts no exact whole-archive size.

A test titled to be selectable by `-t "complete archive retired code"` enumerates the complete current archive and asserts 0 retired `review.attempt-pair-unsubstantiated` findings across it, with no live-zero assertion over the complete archive. A retained live warning in a later delivery therefore does not redden this test.

A test titled to be selectable by `-t "T-005 warning remains observable"` drives the real CLI (`bun ./src/grace.ts review --path . --change C-DECLARATION-GUARD-RETIRE-1-C69B6AB6 --format json`) and asserts the emitted report still contains the retained `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` finding whose `anchorOrHunkKey` is `attempt-pair:T-005:14->15`; it tolerates the non-zero review exit (findings remain) and does not synthesize the report. The finding's `findingId` is recorded, not pinned, because the id depends on the anchor file the empty `run/` directory selects (see `IntentSummary`).

The detector, its positive identical-tree fixtures, the F286 applied-reddens and abandoned-exempt fixtures, finding-id stability, warning severity, and `REVIEW_CATALOG` registration of `review.attempt-pair-identical-tree` are unchanged; no immutable real attempt event is rewritten and no new finding code is added.
